scenario: My neighborhood has a community garden where residents can harvest their own produce on allotted plots of land. There are currently 20 residents who garden there, and each of them has their own plot. Every plot gets a small weekly water allotment due to strict drought rules, and most of the gardeners have gotten used to gardening with these rules in mind. One morning, while grabbing a wheelbarrow from the shed, I noticed a narrow length of tubing running from the main water source to the back of one gardener's plot, clearly siphoning extra water in secret. It was tucked behind a row of tall tomato cages, easy to miss unless I was standing right there. Her plants looked great, and seeing the setup suddenly made all of that make sense. It was allowing her to use way more water than what was allotted to her by bypassing the water meter. This meant there was far less water available for the other gardeners' plants, not nearly enough to keep them all alive. If I stomp on the gardener's plants with my feet, her excess water usage will stop and the other gardeners' plants will continue to survive. If I do not do this, the plants of 9 other gardeners' plots will die from lack of water.
choice: I decide to stomp on the gardener's plants with my feet
entities: i,the 1 gardener secretly siphoning extra water,the 9 remaining gardeners whose plots are not described as dying from the water shortage
outcomes: The gardener's plants are crushed and damaged
The hidden siphon stops drawing extra water for that plot
More of the limited water supply remains available for the other plots
The plants in 9 other gardeners' plots stay alive
The gardener whose plot was stomped becomes upset
